name: create_order
description: Place a new order for a customer and reserve stock for every line item. Items are given by SKU, not product_id; get_product_detail resolves one to the other. payment_method_id must already be on the account. address_id may be omitted only when the account has exactly one saved address. The order is created in the pending state, from which it can still be modified or cancelled.

payment_method_id.description: A payment_method_id from the customer's account, e.g. PM001.

address_id.description: A saved address_id to ship to.

error_returns.when: The customer, or a SKU in items, does not exist.
items is empty, quantity is below 1, the payment method or address is not on the account, or address_id was omitted on a multi-address account.
A requested SKU has fewer units available than the quantity asked for. The response names the units available.
